claim_ceiling: A PASS establishes bounded repair on unseen instances under known verifier semantics, not generator-blind or universal self-healing.
freeze_order: only then generate fresh random seed and blind instances
no V2 mutation after seed generation
evaluate and reveal answer key after decisions
purpose: Test whether the V1 liveness repair generalizes to unseen instances/combinations without reopening false admission.

thresholds.B2_liveness: one-sided 95% Wilson lower bound for VALID finalization > 0.95
thresholds.B3_false_hold: one-sided 95% Wilson upper bound for VALID HOLD < 0.05

unsafe_generation: 1-3 simultaneous hidden fault dimensions sampled after V2 freeze
